findings.evidence: Digest item para:47f646b0 removes the binary-search flowchart. Row 's148 Algorithm Example: Binary Search' records 'removed-on-merit | low | drop | wrong' because 'CalcMid[mid = low + (high - low) / 2]' has unquoted parentheses. A repairable label does not justify dropping the entire substantive algorithm template; this row has no accepted-drop waiver.
findings.fix: Restore a corrected binary-search example into skills/mermaid-diagrams/references/authoring-rules.md section 5, quoting parser-sensitive labels and applying the documented styling rules, and update the recovery row to identify that destination.

findings.evidence: The dbff837f digest states 'removed units (444, showing 40)'; 404 removal items are not available for individual comparison in the supplied digest.
findings.fix: Supply an untruncated digest, or name a complete digest file containing all 444 removal items, so every omitted item can be checked against the current files and recovery record.

findings.evidence: The refactor-eleven-components assertion requires 'an expected rendered height-to-width ratio of 0.4 or more' or a check against that ratio. Authoring-rules.md section 2 now treats a ratio below 0.4 only as a warning and explicitly accepts short, wide diagrams whose text remains readable.
findings.fix: Replace the hard ratio assertion with checks for readability at the target column width and excessive height; accept a readable short, wide result and require splitting only when the documented readability or height threshold is exceeded.

findings.evidence: 'Keep every node-to-node edge the user or the source supplied exactly as it is' is unconditional. The semantic-flowchart-repair branch in SKILL.md explicitly loads this section while permitting changes to incorrect arrows and meaning, so following both instructions can prevent the requested edge correction.
findings.fix: Scope exact edge preservation to layout/grouping changes and syntax-only or appearance-only repairs. Explicitly permit correcting an edge during semantic repair when the supplied facts establish the intended relationship, while retaining the prohibition on replacing node edges with group edges merely to preserve layout.

findings.evidence: The custom-icon branch prescribes 'mmdc --iconPacks @iconify-json/logos ...' without instructing a live interface check or providing a dated source for that vendor CLI flag. Facts not verified online; this review used read-only file inspection.
findings.fix: Before the custom-icon command, instruct the agent to run the installed mmdc --help and confirm --iconPacks and its argument form; alternatively attach the official mermaid-cli source URL and date checked to this instruction.
